name: Velanir Pending Responsibility Context
description: Injects exact-session pending responsibility context, binds one trusted inbound action, and derives scheduling finals from runner receipts.

dryRun.label: Dry Run
dryRun.help: Default ON. An explicit false is necessary but not sufficient for effects: the source must also declare a reviewed actionCommand.

suppressNonFinalReplies.label: Suppress Pending-Turn Non-Final Replies
suppressNonFinalReplies.help: Default ON. Cancels only tool/progress payloads for a fresh, exact-session inbound turn that owns pending responsibility context; ordinary chat is unaffected.

authorizationTtlMs.label: Inbound Authorization Lifetime
authorizationTtlMs.help: Maximum age of one host-observed inbound message that can authorize one pending action. The message id is never model-supplied.

maxInjectionChars.label: Injection Size Cap
maxInjectionChars.help: Maximum characters for the injected pending-interactions block. Over budget, item lines are dropped with a '+N more' indicator.

maxItemsInInjection.label: Max Injected Items
maxItemsInInjection.help: Maximum pending interactions listed inline before collapsing to a count.

strictUserScope.label: Strict User Scope
strictUserScope.help: Default ON. Never inject an interaction that lacks a userId into a user-scoped chat (prevents cross-user leakage).

strictSessionScope.label: Strict Session Scope
strictSessionScope.help: Default ON. Require every interaction to name the exact destination session or conversation before it can be injected or acted on.

sources.workspacePath.label: Responsibility Workspace
sources.workspacePath.help: Directory the runner is executed in (contains runner.mjs).

sources.command.label: Pending Command
sources.command.help: Read-only argv run to source pending interactions. Defaults to node runner.mjs pending.

sources.actionCommand.label: Authoritative Action Command
sources.actionCommand.help: Optional reviewed argv for the runner transaction bridge. There is no default: omit it to keep dry-run-only behavior even when dryRun is false.

sources.userId.label: Scoped User
sources.userId.help: The user these interactions belong to; items are only surfaced/actionable in that user's chat.

sources.sessionKey.label: Destination Session
sources.sessionKey.help: Exact OpenClaw destination session key for this interaction source.
